{{Quote|I traveled off-world before becoming clan leader. I have ''seen'' this Empire, Rikkar-du! They are ''very'' strong! If you think you can keep them from conquering Munto Codru&hellip;!|The clan leader to Rikkar-Du|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 13">[[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]]</ref>}}
The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Codru-Ji]] '''clan leader''' was present when [[Rikkar-Du]] called a meeting of all clan leaders so that they could oppose [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Darth Krayt's Empire]].

==Biography==
Having seen the strength of the Empire first-hand in her travels, during the clan leaders' meeting she argued that the Empire was too powerful for even the united clans, and that they could not stop its conquest of [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]]. Rikkar-Du replied that though they may not be able to stop the conquest, they could interfere with its rule by using the Codru-Ji's well-known abilities to abduct Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governors]].

==Behind the scenes==
The character's only appearance was a small line in [[Legacy (2006) 13|''Legacy'' (2006) 13]].
